proposals.title: Core branded integer types and arithmetic with division rounding modes
proposals.why_now: Every other FASE-1 package depends on @ciclo/core for Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, and Tick nominal types and the divWithMode helper. Currently core exports only CanonicalEncoder. Nothing in world, domain, or application can advance until these types exist and ADR-004's DEFINIR (enforcement of division mode) is resolved by ADR and by lint or type system.

proposals.title: Positional RNG and hash-function ADR
proposals.why_now: ADR-002 marks the hash function as DEFINIR with a strong recommendation of SplitMix64 over FNV-1a. The spec calls INV-02 — price(asset, t) computed directly equals advancing tick by tick — 'the most important test of the project', and that invariant requires a positional RNG. Without rand(), the price generator, macro events, bot policies, and NPC tips cannot start. ADR-002 requires the hash to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists.

proposals.title: Multi-commodity double-entry ledger
proposals.why_now: The ledger is the source of truth for all economic state (INV-04 through INV-07). It must exist before market orders, the tick loop, or save/replay work. Its interface is fully specified: Transaction, Entry, Account, per-commodity balance-zero invariant, causationId on every transaction. The domain package is an empty stub; this is its first substantive deliverable. It depends only on IDEA-001 and can proceed in parallel with IDEA-002.

proposals.title: Electron application bootstrap and FASE-1 minimum installer
proposals.why_now: The spec states explicitly: 'o instalador existe na FASE-1, em forma mínima. Não no fim. Se o empacotamento multiplataforma aparecer depois, o time descobre problema de módulo nativo, de ABI e de caminho de arquivo na última semana.' All four Electron desktop app entry points are empty stubs. INV-29 (contextIsolation, nodeIntegration=false, sandbox=true) cannot be CI-tested until a real Electron bootstrap exists. This is a parallel-track item that does not depend on domain logic.

proposals.title: Price generator with two assets and two noise layers
proposals.why_now: INV-02 — consultable positionally: price(asset, t) must equal arriving at t tick by tick for any t — is the spec's self-described most important test. The fractal octave construction (trendLayer + idiosyncraticNoise) is the first substantive use of the positional RNG and the first use of fixed-point arithmetic in world. Two noise layers and two assets are the FASE-1 minimum. This requires IDEA-001 and IDEA-002. The approach for fixed-point equivalents of transcendental functions must be decided by ADR before implementation.

repository_assessment.current_state: Monorepo infrastructure is complete: CI pipeline, ESLint purity rules, dependency boundary checker, and all package stubs are in place. packages/core exports CanonicalEncoder with ADR-009 accepted (101 tests passing). One ADR is on file (0009-canonical-encoding.md). Every other package — world, domain, application, narrative, contracts, adapters, ui, and all apps/desktop sub-packages — is an empty stub exporting nothing. No nominal types, no positional RNG, no ledger, no price generator, no tick loop, no save system, no CLI replay tool, no benchmark tool, no minimal UI, and no installer exist.
repository_assessment.highest_priority_gap: packages/core lacks the foundational nominal integer types (Money, Quantity, Price, Rate, Tick per ADR-003) and the division helper with explicit rounding modes (ADR-004 DEFINIR must be resolved by ADR) that every downstream FASE-1 package depends on. Until these exist, no work in world, domain, or application can proceed at the type level.

warnings: ADR-004 requires calling division without an explicit rounding mode to be 'an error de compilação ou erro de lint bloqueante' — the enforcement mechanism is DEFINIR and must be written to an ADR before core arithmetic ships. A lint rule targeting the bare / operator on branded types is one approach; a typed helper requiring the mode parameter is another. The choice extends the existing lint rule set.

ADR-002 requires the hash function to be specified bit-by-bit in an ADR before any rand() implementation exists. The spec recommends SplitMix64 over FNV-1a but this remains a DEFINIR. Once any StateHash is computed the hash function is frozen; changing it retroactively invalidates all reference hashes.

The price generator (§5.1) requires fixed-point implementations of functions equivalent to transcendental math (linear interpolation over fractal octaves) that must produce bit-identical results on Windows and Linux under the same Electron/V8 version (INV-19). The approach must be decided by ADR before implementation begins, since the choice affects every price value ever produced.
